meta.title: Half marathon build 2026-2027
meta.escalationClause: If weeks 1-24 are all logged green with no amber since December, add 5% to weeks 27-35 (peak ~78 km). Otherwise do not.

phases.name: Rebuild
phases.brief: Frequency and bone load before speed. Nothing faster than relaxed strides.

phases.name: Base & form
phases.brief: Volume up, threshold introduced as short cruise intervals, cadence retraining.

phases.name: Winter threshold
phases.brief: Pyramidal block. Big easy base, real threshold volume, heavy strength, hills.

phases.name: Race specific
phases.brief: Shift polarized: VO2 intervals plus long blocks at goal half pace.

phases.name: Sharpen & taper
phases.brief: Cut volume hard, keep intensity. No hockey or floorball in the last three weeks.

zones.use: Every run that is not the key session. Most of your week lives here.
Long runs, drifting to the faster end late in the run.
Rare. Long steady blocks in winter.
Cruise intervals and continuous tempo. The engine of this plan.
3-5 min reps in the specific phase.
20 s strides, 200-400 m reps. Form, not lungs.

travelWeekSessions.title: Keep the intensity
travelWeekSessions.detail: 8 × 2 min hard / 1 min easy, or the week's key session shortened by half. Treadmill is fine.

travelWeekSessions.title: One longer easy run
travelWeekSessions.detail: 40–60 min easy, whatever the city gives you.

travelWeekSessions.title: Optional third run
travelWeekSessions.detail: 30 min easy if the schedule opens up. Nice to have, not required.

travelWeekSessions.title: Hotel strength × 2
travelWeekSessions.detail: 10 min: single-leg calf raises 3×15 each, split squats 3×10, pogo hops 3×20, side plank. No equipment needed.
